description: Tag Pilot tracking-health check for a GTM container. Flags tags that can never fire (no triggers, missing triggers, expired schedules), paused tags, unused triggers and variables, non-Google tags without consent settings (web containers), Google tag / GA4 configuration IDs loaded by more than one tag (double counting), and, for a workspace, changes that are not published yet. Reads the live version by default; pass workspace_id to audit a workspace (one extra call for the live version). Findings are sorted high → info.

account_id.description: Numeric Tag Manager account ID, from list_accounts.

container_id.description: Numeric container ID from list_containers, or the public ID ("GTM-XXXXXXX").

version_id.description: Read this container version ("live" or a number from list_versions). Default: the live (published) version.

workspace_id.description: Read this workspace (unpublished changes included), from list_workspaces. Omit both workspace_id and version_id for the live version.

name: audit_container
title: Tag Pilot check: container audit
